Flask Application Containerized Python backend Handles routes and app logic Ephemeral messaging workflow One-time message access Stores and retrieves MySQL data

CI/CD Pipeline — GitHub Actions Deployment
GitHub Repository
Stores application source code Push changes to main branch
GitHub Actions
Runs automated deployment workflow Secure SSH connection to EC2 SSH credentials managed via GitHub Secrets
Deployment Workflow
1 GitHub Actions connects to EC2 using SSH
2 EC2 pulls latest project changes from GitHub
3 Docker Compose rebuilds and deploys containers
cost automation block
Automation & Cost Optimization
EventBridge Rule 1
Daily Cron · 7:00 PM IST Scheduled EC2 Start
EventBridge Rule 2
Daily Cron · 8:00 PM IST Scheduled EC2 Stop
Triggers Lambda
AWS Lambda Automation
1 Starts EC2 instance automatically
2 Detects newly assigned public IP
3 Creates or updates Route 53 A-record
4 Deletes A-record before stopping EC2
Project Purpose
Built mainly to learn and understand Docker, Containerization, and CI/CD workflows
Focused on deploying containerized applications on AWS using CI/CD workflows
Infrastructure optimized to keep the live demo publicly accessible at low AWS cost
